name: T3 Code
description: Start coding tasks in your T3 Code projects, follow progress, and continue existing threads from OpenTeam.

setup.title: Connect T3 Code
setup.description: Paste the MCP URL from your T3 Code environment. OpenTeam validates the URL, then opens T3's authorization page. No client ID or API key is needed.
steps: In T3 Code, choose Use T3 Code in another app (MCP), or Copy MCP URL from your environment's menu.
Paste the complete URL below. Use T3 Connect or reachable HTTPS when OpenTeam runs on another computer.
Authorize OpenTeam on T3's page. If T3 asks for a one-time approval code, enter it there; OpenTeam does not save that code.
Choose your access level in T3. Read only can inspect threads. Auto lets the coding provider review routine actions automatically and ask about others; it is not unrestricted access.
Return to OpenTeam. The connection is ready after its authenticated MCP tool discovery succeeds. Keep the T3 host online.

fields.label: T3 Code MCP URL
fields.helpText: Paste the full URL ending in /mcp, not a pairing link or approval code. HTTPS is required except for localhost.
